OpenTrack.//RequireHttps: Set true to force HTTPS (redirect + HSTS). Leave false for a trusted-LAN plain-HTTP deployment. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
OpenTrack.//BootstrapAdmin: Optional out-of-band first administrator. If set, the WEB host promotes/creates this account to Administrator at startup so you never rely on 'first registered user wins'. Prefer env vars / user-secrets over committing the password. Honored by the web host only (the API host shares the same database). Leave blank to use first-user-becomes-admin.
OpenTrack.//Email: Set Enabled=true and fill in an SMTP server to send confirmation/password-reset email. Left disabled, those emails are logged (with any link) instead of sent.
OpenTrack.//Ai: Optional AI assist. Set Enabled=true and configure a provider to turn on features like smart triage. Provider='anthropic' (Claude, default) uses api.anthropic.com with an Anthropic key. Provider='openai' uses ANY OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or a LOCAL engine like Ollama (BaseUrl='http://localhost:11434/v1') or LM Studio ('http://localhost:1234/v1') that keeps all data on your machine. Set Model to match the provider. Any key is billed to THAT provider's account, separate from any Claude subscription. Prefer env vars / user-secrets over committing the key. See docs/AI_ASSIST.md.
OpenTrack.//Backup: Optional scheduled database backups. Set Enabled=true to have the server periodically write a consistent SQLite snapshot (VACUUM INTO) every IntervalHours to Directory (blank = a 'backups' folder next to the database), keeping the newest Retention copies. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md (Backups section).
